verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS meeting-notes product, so the axis applies, but no evidence shows Fellow lets users opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The nearby controls are different features: pausing recording, retention policies, MCP enablement and the pricing item 'Keyword tracking'. None of them is a telemetry or analytics opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
